title: Sharp discrete Hardy constants in dimensions three and four and strict upper bounds from dimension nine
summary: For $N\ge3$, let $C(N)$ be the optimal constant in the nearest-neighbour Hardy inequality on $\mathbb Z^N$ with $u(0)=0$, and set $A_N=(N-2)^2/4$. We prove that the continuum coefficient remains an upper bound, $C(N)\le A_N$, in every dimension, and determine the exact values $C(3)=A_3=1/4$ and $C(4)=A_4=1$. In higher dimensions we show $C(N)<A_N$ for $N=9,10$ and obtain the explicit bound \[ C(N)\le 3N-\sqrt{N^2+8N-8}<2N\qquad(N\ge3), \] which lies below $A_N$ from dimension eleven onward.
